system.description:
Used when you are attacked. You may instantly [Safe Move] up to 1 Sq. 

(Fate 1): You can immediately [Safe Move (Forced)] the enemy that attacked you up to 1 Sq.

A skill that allows you to see the length of your prey and measure the optimal distance. Making no mistake is the unquestionable logic of war. You know that getting rid of it is the trick that deserves to be called stupid.
